description: View a PDF and its translation side by side, with the translation laid over the original layout. Translates with GitHub Copilot or another language model in VS Code.
config.targetLanguage: The language to translate into, named as you would name it to a translator, such as `Japanese`, `Simplified Chinese` or `Brazilian Portuguese`.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In an untrusted workspace, a target language set by the workspace is ignored, because the setting becomes part of the prompt.
